Our Services

Personalized quotes for every space. Clients may also request services that aren’t listed, we accommodate customized requests whenever possible.

Luxury Residential Cleaning

Weekly · Biweekly · Monthly
  • Dusting and accessible surfaces throughout
  • Kitchen counters, sink, stovetop, appliance exteriors
  • Bathrooms and mirrors, detailed and refreshed
  • Vacuuming, mopping, trash, light straightening, beds made with your linens
Add-ons availableInside oven, refrigerator, or cabinets; baseboards; interior windows; laundry; dishes; customized requests.

Airbnb Turnover Cleaning

Guest-ready every stay
  • Full reset of bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchen, living areas, floors
  • Trash removal, bed-making, and linen replacement
  • Staging and a final presentation check
  • Onsite laundry or swapping clean host-provided linen sets
Host supportRestocking your provided essentials, completion photos, and reporting of visible damage, missing items, or maintenance concerns.

Deep & Seasonal Cleaning

Top-to-bottom refresh
  • Everything in standard residential service
  • Baseboards, doors, trim, and fixtures
  • Cabinet exteriors and buildup-prone areas
  • The overlooked details that make a space feel new
Best forFirst-time, seasonal, move-in/move-out, post-event, special occasions, or homes not professionally cleaned recently.

Commercial Cleaning

Offices & workspaces
  • Offices, professional suites, and retail spaces
  • Property-management common areas
  • Churches, salons, and medical offices
  • One-time, weekly, biweekly, or customized recurring service
Medical officesRoutine non-clinical areas only, no biohazards, sharps, regulated medical waste, or clinical decontamination.
Featured Service

Event Cleaning & Venue Reset

Weddings, receptions, corporate gatherings, church events, and private parties. We prepare the space before guests arrive, clear it after they leave, or handle both ends so the venue is returned exactly as it was found, on schedule and within your contracted deadline.

Pre-Event Setup & Venue Preparation

Before guests arrive
  • Full clean of event spaces, entryways, and guest restrooms
  • Table, chair, and seating arrangement per your floor plan
  • Linen placement, surface wipe-down, and final presentation check
  • Trash and recycling stations staged and lined
  • Walkthrough with your coordinator before doors open

Post-Event Breakdown & Venue Reset

After guests leave
  • Clearing tables, breakdown of chairs, tables, and staging
  • Trash and recycling removal to your venue’s designated area
  • Floors swept, mopped, or vacuumed; spills and spot stains treated
  • Restrooms and kitchen or prep areas reset
  • Room returned to its original layout before your reset deadline

Complete Event Package

Both services, one team
  • Everything in pre-event setup and post-event reset
  • One point of contact from setup through final walkthrough
  • Optional mid-event attendant for restrooms and trash
  • Coordinated to your venue’s access window and curfew
  • Simplest option when your contract requires same-night clearing

Event work is quoted by guest count, venue size, table and chair count, and how tight the reset window is. Share your details and we’ll confirm the crew size and timing. Late-night and same-night resets are available.

Founder’s Story

Rooted in Care,
Inspired by Hospitality

Signature Stay Cleaning was founded from a passion for creating beautifully maintained spaces and delivering an elevated standard of care. Through her experience in property management, Christine developed a deep understanding of the importance of cleanliness, presentation, and dependable service.

She created Signature Stay Cleaning to provide clients with thoughtful, detail-oriented cleaning that reflects professionalism, excellence, and genuine care.

“Excellent service means listening carefully, understanding each client’s expectations, and consistently delivering a result that meets or exceeds them.”

Good to Know

Quotes & Pricing
Personalized quotes only. No minimum service charge and no instant booking.
Deposit
25% non-refundable deposit reserves your date and is applied to your final balance.

Contact us within 24 hours and we’ll inspect and re-clean the affected area.

Reviews

Now Hiring

Join a Team That Takes Pride in the Details

Signature Stay Cleaning is hiring Cleaning Technicians across Prince William County, Manassas, Fairfax, Loudoun, and the City of Alexandria. If you work carefully, show up when you say you will, and take satisfaction in a room that looks genuinely finished, we’d like to hear from you.

Start Your Application Read the Role

Cleaning Technician

Three ways to work with us. Tell us on the application which ones interest you, you can choose more than one.

Part-Time

Scheduled shifts

A regular weekly schedule of roughly 15 to 28 hours, built around recurring residential and commercial clients. Best if you want predictable days and a steady route. Paid hourly, with mileage between job sites.

Flexible / On-Call

Work when you’re available

You tell us the days and hours you can take, and we send jobs that fit. Useful for Airbnb turnovers, last-minute deep cleans, and event work, which often lands on evenings and weekends. No minimum hours, but the more availability you share, the more we can send.

Independent Contractor

1099 · Per job

For experienced cleaners operating their own business. You accept jobs individually, set your own methods within our quality standards, and invoice per completed job. Requires your own transportation, general liability insurance, and a W-9.

What you’ll do

  • Clean residential homes, short-term rentals, offices, and event venues to our written checklist for each property
  • Dust, wipe, and sanitize kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living areas, including fixtures and accessible surfaces
  • Vacuum, sweep, and mop floors; remove trash and replace liners
  • Make beds, replace linens, and stage rooms so the space presents well for the next guest or client
  • Handle event work when scheduled: setting and resetting tables and chairs, clearing after guests, and returning venues to their original layout on deadline
  • Restock client-provided supplies and report damage, missing items, or maintenance concerns with photos
  • Use supplies and equipment safely, following product labels and client preferences (including eco-friendly options on request)
  • Communicate arrival, delays, and completion promptly, and treat every home and its contents with care and discretion

What we ask for

  • 18 years or older, and legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Reliable transportation to job sites across Northern Virginia
  • Dependable communication by phone or text, and consistent punctuality
  • A careful, detail-driven approach, prior cleaning experience is welcome but not required for part-time and on-call roles
  • Comfortable standing, bending, reaching, and lifting up to 25 lbs throughout a shift
  • Willingness to complete a background check before your first assignment
  • Professional, respectful conduct in occupied homes and businesses
  • Independent contractors: proven cleaning experience, own equipment and supplies, general liability insurance, and a completed W-9
